footer.tagline: A delivery-only kitchen. No walk-ins, no dining room - just food finished the moment it's ordered.
footer.demoNote: Portfolio project, not a real business. Reviews, quotes and certifications are placeholders.

hero.headline: You'll never see our kitchen. Only taste what leaves it.
hero.sub: No dining room, no hostess stand, no rent for a room you'd sit in for an hour. One commercial kitchen, a small team of chefs, and every plate finished the moment your order arrives.

kitchen.heading: The kitchen you'll never stand in
kitchen.p1: A cloud kitchen has no dining room, so nothing about your evening is spent on one. No printed menus left on a table for the next four guests, no hostess stand, no square footage sitting empty at 3pm. That budget goes into the kitchen instead - better cuts, tighter sourcing, a smaller menu done properly.
kitchen.p2: Every order is cooked to fire, not held warm under a lamp waiting for a table to be ready. You're not seated near the kitchen. You're the only reason it's running tonight.

howItWorks.heading: Order to doorstep
howItWorks.sub: Three steps, same as any kitchen - you just don't have to sit in it.

plated.title: Plated to order
plated.description: Nothing sits pre-made. Your dish is cooked and finished the moment it's placed.

arrives.title: Arrives dining-ready
arrives.description: Sealed in insulated, course-separated packaging so it reaches you as the chef meant it.

standards.heading: Our standards
standards.quote: “I never plated a dish for someone I couldn’t see. Now every plate has to speak for itself.”

sourcing.title: Sourcing
sourcing.description: Produce and meat sourced daily from a small circle of Delta-region farms.

hygiene.title: Hygiene
hygiene.description: HACCP-certified kitchen with daily audits, not annual ones.

packaging.title: Packaging
packaging.description: Leak-tested, compostable containers, sealed course by course.

consistency.title: Consistency
consistency.description: Every plate finished by the chef on duty - never assembled by a courier.

reviews.heading: From the last table we don't have

t1.quote: Every course arrived exactly when the last one finished, like they knew our pace before we did.
t1.author: Nourhan, Maadi

t2.quote: I stopped telling people it's delivery. It just doesn't taste like delivery.
t2.author: Omar, Zamalek

t3.quote: The lamb shoulder shows up at our table more reliably than most of our dinner guests.
t3.author: Salma, Heliopolis
